name: pos-checkout-mvp
description: Production-ready Point-of-Sale system with offline-first support

scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently "npm run dev:backend:desktop" "npm run dev:frontend:desktop" "npm run dev:electron:desktop"
scripts.build:backend: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=packages/payment-adapters && npm run build --workspace=apps/backend
scripts.build:desktop: cross-env DESKTOP_MODE=true DESKTOP_SQLITE_PATH=file:../data/checkout-desktop.db npm run build --workspace=apps/frontend && cross-env DESKTOP_MODE=true DESKTOP_SQLITE_PATH=file:../data/checkout-desktop.db npm run desktop:init-db && npm run build --workspace=apps/desktop && npm run package --workspace=apps/desktop
scripts.build:functions: npm run build --workspace=@pos-checkout/shared && npm run build --workspace=@pos-checkout/payment-adapters && npm run build --workspace=@pos-checkout/backend && node ./scripts/copy-backend-dist.js && npm run build --workspace=functions
scripts.deploy:web: npm run build --workspace=apps/frontend && npx firebase deploy --only hosting
